flows.title: Share a meeting report
steps: Open the meeting report and click Share. Managing sharing needs editor access, which you have if you invited Read to the meeting; without it the button only lets you request access from the report owner.
In the Share Report dialog, type a person's name — only if they already have a Read account — or their email address. In a Workspace you can also pick a team or the whole Workspace.
Choose whether they are a viewer or an editor, and whether to notify them by email with an optional message, then click Share. The report then appears under their Shared with me tab.
To change someone's access or remove it later, click Viewer or Editor beside them under People with access.
Leave Link access at the bottom on People with access unless the report should be public: Anyone with the link lets anyone holding the URL view it without signing in.

flows.title: Download a meeting report
steps: Open the meeting report. Anyone who can view it can download it, unless their Workspace has turned report downloads off.
Click Download towards the top right of the report to open its menu.
Click the option you want; the download starts for that section of the report. Video, as an .mp4, is offered only when video playback was enabled on the report and on the Enterprise plan.
